messages:
Jordan: heads-up: onboarding load test caused a client-side storm — lots of 429s. looks like paginator prefetch + retry spiraled.
Priya: can you share the sampleapp config that triggered it?
Jordan: default sampleapp with prefetch_pages=3 and retry.max_attempts=3, backoff_ms=20. reproducible with the load script.
Sam: that short backoff means retries overlap heavily with prefetch. essentially you get prefetch * retries in-flight.
Nina: short-term mitigation: change quickstart defaults to prefetch_pages=1 and backoff_ms=200. also add a note in the onboarding guide.
Jordan: filing a tiny PR to change defaults and add a troubleshooting blurb. will link here.
Infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026 - client-prefetch-retry-surge (assigned: eng-devex)
Priya: long-term ideas: 1) make hedged/retry attempts count against the paginator's concurrency tickets so they don't silently exceed quotas; 2) add jitter to backoffs; 3) expose a global in-flight cap per cursor that includes hedges/retries.
Sam: agree. also add a telemetry counter retry_attempts vs original_attempts so Console can show the multiplier effect.
Nina: we should add an e2e test that fault-injects 429s and asserts in-flight <= configured concurrency. if it regresses, fail the job.
Jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/621 toggles safer defaults and adds the doc note.
Priya: I'll pick up the SDK change to consume concurrency tickets for hedges/retries and add hedged_attempts telemetry.
Sam: let's also consider an automatic client mitigation that backs off prefetch when 429 rate crosses a threshold for the session.
Nina: added a short troubleshooting snippet to devex playbook. thanks team :thumbsup:
Jordan: thanks all, will monitor staging after the PR lands.
